QuestInfo.name: [LINE FRIENDS] Enter Through the Gift Shop
QuestInfo.0: Which souvenir from the list is CONY's must-have item of the day? You'll have to ask her to find out.
QuestInfo.1: Bring CONY the hot, hot Maple World souvenirs she craves. Each souvenir is obtained through a different method, but if you're having trouble, you can always take Cassandra up on her offer to provide it in exchange for some good ol' monster hunting.
QuestInfo.2: You helped out CONY by bringing her the #bMaple World Special Collection#k souvenir she wanted and received a reward.

0.conditionContent: Pick up today's souvenir for the collection

default.0: So, how are you coming along with that souvenir? Easy peasy, right? I'm looking forward to seeing it!\r\nGather #b #R64515ExcStrRef64515# #k\r\n#r* You can find more details in the [LINE FRIENDS] Ask CONY! quest.
